reporting-org.narrative: Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency

description.narrative: The Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency implements humanitarian operations to support UN agencies with experts and service packages. The overall objective is to strengthen efficiency in the humanitarian system and to contribute to humanitarian assistance and protection for crisis affected people. Operations are funded by Sida through an agreement that allows the agency to initiate missions from July 1 2026 to December 31 2029 with an end to the implementation period set to June 30 2030. Total funding is 455 million SEK with 65 million SEK allocated for 2026 and 130 million SEK allocated for each year during the period 2027-2029. Decisions regarding which countries, organisations and crises that will be supported under this agreement will be made continuously during the implementation period. Therefore reporting will be updated regularly during the period, but in the beginning of the period there will be limited data for many categories.

participating-org.narrative: WFP, UNHCR, UNICEF, OCHA, IOM, UNFPA, UN Women, WHO, UNOPS, UNDSS

humanitarian-scope.narrative: Humanitarian support to a wide range of humanitarian contexts in several countries.
